title: U.C.F.A.R.U.G (Programmer art Mobs)
description: UGLY creatures for a REALLY UGLY gameplay is a mod that adds programmer art designs for newer mobs!
body:
This Resource pack is meant to be paired with [Golden Days](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/golden-days/versions), but it is not required!

Requires [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/home) or [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) & [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)

Current mobs:
- Bees
- Axolotl
- Sniffer
